active_phase.immediate_objective: BATCH-02 is CLOSED / ACCEPTED by architect ruling and must not be reopened. BATCH-03 delivered two grouped corrections. A) NEXT PEDIDO NUMBER SUGGESTION: exactly one forward-only migration, db/90_pedido_proximo_numero_suggestion_rpc, was applied once to shared development ucrjtfswnfdlxwtmxnoo, moving the terminal from db/89 to db/90. It adds ONLY the read-only RPC public.consultar_proximo_numero_pedido() RETURNS BIGINT and touches no table, column, constraint, trigger, policy, existing function, existing grant or row. The admin new-Pedido field now OPENS prefilled with the numeric candidate instead of an 'Automatico' placeholder, under the helper text 'Sugestao automatica. Voce pode alterar antes de salvar.'; the visible number is the number attempted on save. AUTHORITY: the candidate is read from the identity sequence state (pg_sequence_last_value plus seqincrement/seqstart from pg_catalog.pg_sequence, which unlike the pg_sequences view is not privilege-filtered); a virgin sequence correctly returns seqstart. MAX(numero)+1 is FORBIDDEN because an explicit high number already advanced the sequence, a rolled-back creation consumed a value no row carries, and gaps are accepted by design. CONSULTATION NEITHER RESERVES NOR CONSUMES: nextval, setval and currval are never called, proved on the applied object after stripping comments, so opening the form burns no number. The result is ADVISORY; UNIQUE(pedidos.numero) remains authoritative. CONCURRENT CONFLICT is controlled and never silent: an untouched suggestion that becomes occupied is refreshed from the RPC, the field shows the new candidate, the operator is told which number was lost and which replaced it, and the Pedido is NOT created; a manually typed occupied number is PRESERVED with exactly 'Este numero de pedido ja esta em uso.'. If the RPC is unavailable the field stays empty under a controlled 'Sugestao indisponivel' state with no MAX fallback. SECURITY: SECURITY DEFINER, SET search_path = public, gated on public.is_admin(), EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC and anon, granted to authenticated; service_role retains EXECUTE from the project default and is still gated by the body. The client-facing form neither shows the number nor calls the RPC. B) COMPACT OPERATIONAL LAYOUT: the architect REJECTED the fixed two-row Dados gerais layout for wide desktop. It is now ONE proportional grid rendering Cliente | Numero | Data | Prazo | Status on a single line at wide desktop (measured 30.0/17.0/17.0/17.0/19.0 percent at 1440px), adapting by available width through the new data-rv-pedido-dados contract in css/responsive.css: 5 -> 3 (the declared 3+2) -> 2 -> 1 columns, measured live at 1440/1100/900/375px with documentElement.scrollWidth <= clientWidth at every width. Density is 16px card padding, 12px title-to-fields, 12px card-to-card, 14px column gap and ~40px field height, all measured; the empty message line now reserves 0px instead of a permanent band. The item row, header and summary lost dead padding while every control kept its size, so no click target shrank. The BATCH-02 extraction is preserved: no item modal returned and Tipo remains before Modelo. STRUCTURAL: the numbering contract was extracted to js/screens/pedido-numero-sugestao.js (108 lines) so no second surface can reinvent MAX+1; pedido-form.js is 794 lines, inside the code-health exceptional tier. LIVE VALIDATION: one bounded transaction ending in ROLLBACK proved the admin candidate 70, five identical consecutive calls, an unmoved sequence (69 before and after), 42501 for a real non-admin, for authenticated without a JWT and for anon at the privilege layer, the next real insert receiving exactly 70, and the post-consumption candidate 71. ZERO RESIDUE: pedidos unchanged at its two real rows (numero 2 and 67) and pedido_itens at 10; the sequence advanced 68 -> 70 from two rolled-back automatic inserts, an accepted gap. REGRESSION: 4326 tests, 4325 pass / 1 fail, the sole failure being the accepted Category-E tests/g14-c-bridge-smoke.test.js at its byte-for-byte baseline condition. BOUNDARY: production UNCHANGED and NOT ACCESSED; no Vercel, main, origin or tag action. Architect VISUAL acceptance of the compact layout is outstanding and is not self-accepted.
